description.narrative: This Project Initiation Plan (PIP) outlines UNDPs support to the Ministry of Health and Social Protection of the Population of the Republic of Tajikistan (MOHSPP RT) for procuring and delivering medical products to combat Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV). This contributes on enhancing antiretroviral therapy (ART) access and HIV treatment outcomes for People Living with HIV (PLHIV) in Tajikistan with a focus on procurement and delivery of health products (including antiretroviral drugs - ARVs for PLHIV and Laboratory reagents, test kits and consumables). The initiative is funded by the Ministry of Health and Social Protection of the Population of the Republic of Tajikistan (MOHSPP RT) in the amount of US$126,511.12. The implementation period is from 19 February 2026 to 18 August 2027.The procurement actions follow UNDP rules and policies as agreed in the Financial Agreement. Upon delivery, the products will be handed over to MOHSPP. This is in line with Tajikistan’s National Health Strategy 2030 and UNDPs strategic priorities, with a project gender marker of GEN1.

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).

The Implementing Partner shall ensure that all of its obligations set forth under the section entitled “Legal Context and/or Risk Management Standard Clauses” are passed on to each responsible party, subcontractor and sub-recipient and that all the clauses under this section entitled “Risk Management” are included, mutatis mutandis, in all sub-contracts or sub-agreements entered into further to the Project Document
